product.title: From Jackson Hole: Yellowstone Old Faithful, Waterfalls and Wildlife Day Tour

description.text: Enjoy a full day exploring Yellowstone National Park on a small-group tour from the comfort of a vehicle that lets you cover more sights in less time. Riding along with a naturalist guide, you'll spend the morning searching for bears, wolves, elk, moose, and bison. Stops include Yellowstone National Park, Old Faithful, Old Faithful Inn, Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone, Yellowstone Lake, Lower Yellowstone River Falls. Plus, you'll learn more about the park's history, ecology, and geology than you would alone.Travel through Grand Teton National Park in the early morning to observe more animals Visit off-the-beaten-path places that most travelers Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
